plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: A stacked context-window bar above the prompt, colored like /context, with cost estimates, compaction and cost warnings, and per-subagent cache-rewrite tracking.

plugins.name: codegraph-worktree
plugins.description: Makes CodeGraph work in git worktrees: copies the index into a new worktree (copy-on-write where the file system can), indexes repositories that have none, and recommends installing CodeGraph when it is missing.
